title: Sanctions Screening Service OOM Crash — Payment Processing Stall

content.summary: The sanctions-screening service crashed with an out-of-memory (OOM) error at 09:17 UTC on 2024-03-19 after a daily list update loaded the full OFAC SDN list into JVM heap without chunking. Because the payment gateway enforces a hard dependency on sanctions clearance, all payment processing stalled for 61 minutes.

timeline.event: Scheduled daily OFAC SDN list refresh begins downloading and parsing 1.4 GB XML file
sanctions-screening JVM OOM error; pod crashes and enters CrashLoopBackOff
payment-gateway detects sanctions-screening unavailable; activates HOLD_PAYMENTS circuit
P1 declared; compliance team and platform engineering paged
Hotfix deployed: list loader updated to stream-parse XML in 50 MB chunks
sanctions-screening healthy; payment-gateway HOLD_PAYMENTS circuit released

content.root_cause: The OFAC SDN list update routine (updated 2024-03-18 to accommodate a larger list format) loaded the entire 1.4 GB XML document into memory as a DOM tree before processing. The sanctions-screening pod had a JVM heap limit of 512 MB set in the Kubernetes resource manifest. The prior SDN list was 380 MB and fit within the heap limit; the updated list exceeded it.
contributing_factors: Memory limit not revised when SDN list format was updated (configuration drift)
No memory stress test run against new SDN list format before deployment
Payment gateway HOLD_PAYMENTS circuit correctly activated but had no partial-clearance fallback for low-risk domestic payments

impact.regulatory_risk: HIGH — payment processing halt could trigger PRA notification if > 2 hours

immediate: Hotfix: stream-parse SDN XML in chunks (JIRA COMP-501)
Increase JVM heap limit to 2 GB as interim measure
short_term: Replace DOM parsing with StAX streaming parser (JIRA COMP-502)
Add memory load test to CI pipeline for sanctions-screening (JIRA COMP-503)
Implement risk-stratified payment clearance: allow low-value domestic payments via cached list during list refresh (JIRA PAY-9120)
long_term: Migrate SDN list storage to an incrementally-updatable graph database
Introduce sanctions-screening service mesh with blue-green list refresh
Define explicit SLO for sanctions clearance availability (ref: POL-008)
